method intersection(interval1: (int, int), interval2: (int, int)) returns (result: string)
    requires interval1.0 <= interval1.1 // start of interval1 is less than or equal to end
    requires interval2.0 <= interval2.1 // start of interval2 is less than or equal to end
    requires interval1.1 >= interval1.0 // interval1 is a valid closed interval
    requires interval2.1 >= interval2.0 // interval2 is a valid closed interval
    ensures result == "YES" || result == "NO" // result is either "YES" or "NO"

    ensures (result == "NO" ==> !(lengthOfIntersection(interval1, interval2) > 0 && isPrime(lengthOfIntersection(interval1, interval2)))) // if result is "NO", length of intersection is not prime or zero

method lengthOfIntersection(interval1: (int, int), interval2: (int, int)) returns (length: int)
    requires interval1.0 <= interval1.1
    requires interval2.0 <= interval2.1
    ensures length == max(0, min(interval1.1, interval2.1) - max(interval1.0, interval2.0)) // length of intersection is calculated
    ensures length >= 0 // length is non-negative

function isPrime(n: int) : bool
    requires n >= 0 // n should be a non-negative integer
    ensures (isPrime(n) ==> (n > 1 && forall i: int :: 2 <= i <= sqrt(n) ==> n % i != 0)) // n is prime if it is greater than 1 and not divisible by any integer from 2 to sqrt(n)
